root.name: スチール・ダイナミクス

rows.ja: 鋼材の顧客(相手の資料に記載)
競合(相手の資料に記載)

companies.name: ニュー・プロセス・スチール

relations.text: 持分45%を持っていた鋼材加工会社の残り55%を2025年12月に取得
relations.text_en: Bought the remaining 55% of the steel processor in December 2025

source.label: Steel Dynamics 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We completed the acquisition of the remaining 55% interest in New Process Steel, L.P.

relations.text: SGHとSteel Dynamicsが共同で、BlueScope Steelの全株取得を提案(成立は未定)
relations.text_en: SGH and Steel Dynamics jointly proposed for SGH to acquire all of BlueScope Steel (no certainty of a deal)

source.label: SGH・Steel Dynamics 共同発表(8-K添付)
source.label_en: SGH and Steel Dynamics joint announcement (8-K exhibit)
source.quote: for SGH to acquire 100% of BlueScope Steel Ltd (ASX:BSL) by way of a scheme of arrangement (the Proposal).

companies.name: ブルースコープ・スチール

relations.text: SGHとSteel Dynamicsが共同で買収を提案した相手(協議は継続中)
relations.text_en: Target of the joint SGH-Steel Dynamics acquisition proposal; talks ongoing

source.label: SGH・Steel Dynamics 共同発表(8-K添付)
source.label_en: SGH and Steel Dynamics joint announcement (8-K exhibit)
source.quote: Discussions with BSL in relation to the Proposal remain incomplete and ongoing.

companies.name: ノースウエスト・パイプ

relations.text: Northwest Pipeが10-Kで、鋼材の仕入先の一社としてSteel Dynamicsを挙げる
relations.text_en: Northwest Pipe lists Steel Dynamics among its steel suppliers

source.label: Northwest Pipe 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our suppliers include Steel Dynamics, Inc., Nucor Corporation, SSAB, North Star BlueScope Steel, United States Steel Corporation, and JSW Steel USA.

relations.text: Atkoreが10-Kで、鋼材の主な仕入先の一社としてSteel Dynamicsを挙げる
relations.text_en: Atkore names Steel Dynamics among its primary steel suppliers

source.label: Atkore 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our primary suppliers of steel are Cleveland-Cliffs, Steel Dynamics and Nucor

companies.name: フリードマン・インダストリーズ

relations.text: Steel Dynamicsのテキサス州シントン製鉄所の敷地を99年契約で借り、加工拠点を構える
relations.text_en: Runs a processing facility on land leased for 99 years at Steel Dynamics' Sinton, Texas mill campus

source.label: Friedman Industries 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: The new facility is on the campus of Steel Dynamics, Inc.'s ("SDI") new flat roll steel mill in Sinton, Texas

relations.text: Metallusが10-Kで、棒鋼の主な競合としてSteel Dynamicsを挙げる
relations.text_en: Metallus names Steel Dynamics among its principal competitors in bar products

source.label: Metallus 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: For bar products up to 9-inch in diameter, domestic producers Steel Dynamics, Inc. and Nucor Corporation (in some cases up to 10-inch) are our principal competitors.

relations.text: Gerdauが年次報告で、主な競合としてSteel Dynamicsを挙げる
relations.text_en: Gerdau names Steel Dynamics among its principal competitors

source.label: Gerdau 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: The Company's principal competitors include Commercial Metals Company (CMC), Nucor Corporation, and Steel Dynamics Inc.

relations.text: Grupo Simecが年次報告で、米国の主な競合としてSteel Dynamicsを挙げる
relations.text_en: Grupo Simec names Steel Dynamics among its principal US competitors

source.label: Grupo Simec 20-F(2024年度)
source.quote: We believe our principal competitors in the United States, depending on the product, include Nucor, Corporation, Charter Steel, Steel Dynamics

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
